text:
kai: Heads up — saw ~30 hosts in us-west2 marked 'local-ssd:degraded' by fleet agent during a scale-up. GPU attaches failing when autoscaler hits those racks. 

sara: Ugh. Is this SMART attr creep again? Which attr showed up?

kai: Looks like 'raw_writes' and 'percent_used' jumped. Ops agent flagged PM=197 threshold. Example from one host:
```
# smartctl -A /dev/nvme0n1
226 Raw_Writes 0x0032 100 100 0 - 197
177 Media_Wearout_Indicator 0x0012 98 98 1 - 12
```

jon: That 197 number matches the new cleaner policy we rolled last week. Could be correlated.

maria: @kai any host IDs? Need to check if it's concentrated on a single tenant or a region-level flapping.

kai: hostids: gnode-uw2-11*, gnode-uw2-12*, gnode-uw2-14. All same HW batch.

infra-oncall: I'm seeing correlated scrub jobs bumped at 02:15 UTC — the janitor overlap was higher than expected. Could be causing write amplification.

sara: Timeline: janitor ramped -> more background writes -> percent_used spikes -> fleet marks degraded -> allocator avoids nodes -> scale-up pulls from other zones -> capacity hit -> manifests as gpu attach failures. 

jon: Short-term mitigation: increase PM threshold from 197 -> 200 for scaling decisions? Risk: masks real wear.

maria: Long-term: revert the janitor ramp or throttle scrub concurrency on that HW batch; add per-node io-budget to limit background writes during scale-ups.

kai: For immediate: infra-oncall can temporarily mark the three host groups as 'no-alloc' for non-critical autoscaling? That buys time.

infra-oncall: I'll put a tag and open a PagerDuty incident for follow-up. PD:INC-1234

ops-bot: Deploy bot: Reminder — scrub-sampler rollout was deployed 03:00 UTC to us-west2. Rollback option: `kubectl set image deploy/janitor janitor=janitor:v1.4.2`.

sara: Can we also add an alert for SMART attr slope > 10% over 24h? This would catch fast ramps.

jon: Filed infra ticket: INFRA-4521 with suggested mitigations + HW batch check.

maria: Assigning owners: @jon owns rollback decision, @sara owns alerting, @kai to collect SMART dumps. I'll follow up in the ticket.

kai: Copy — uploading a couple more raw smart dumps to the ticket.

sara: Thanks. If we see continued failures, we'll temporarily route scale-ups to eu-west until a safe fix is in place :airplane:

jon: +1. Keep me posted.
